# Cell Editing

Cell Editing component

## Overview

- **Category**: tables
- **Base Library**: custom

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { CellEditing } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<CellEditing>
  Content
</CellEditing>
```

## Variants

- Disabled
- Small
